name: SystemEXE,Inc.
summary: SystemEXE, Inc. is in the system integration business, covering business system development and migration, building IT infrastructure, cloud integration, AI and DX solutions, databases and data utilization, PMO support, offshore development, groupware workflow, IoT, and operations and maintenance. Its clients span manufacturing, insurance, medical care, petroleum and chemicals. Incorporated in 1998, it has its headquarters in Chuo, Japan.
